title: Operations ran on
WhatsApp, spreadsheets and paper.
context.body: ReSrishti runs a zero-landfill facility with nine recycling technologies under one roof, serving industrial, hospital, FMCG and corporate clients across Telangana. Day-to-day operations lived in spreadsheets, WhatsApp threads and hand-stitched PDFs, which slowed things down for clients who need audit-ready paperwork for ESG reporting.
before: Pickup requests arrived on WhatsApp and were scheduled by hand
Field attendance was hard to verify from the office
Certificates of Disposal were typed in Word, signed and scanned
Client records lived in spreadsheets and PDF threads
after: Every pickup tracked from request to weighed, processed and certified
Geofenced, selfie-verified check-ins with a GPS trail
Certificates generated as branded PDFs from recorded weights
Clients self-serve pickups, certificates and impact in their own portal

why: They wanted one partner to turn a facility run on WhatsApp, spreadsheets and paper into a single system spanning the public website, workforce app and client portal, and to keep building on it as operations grew.
deliverables: Public website with facility pages, pickup booking and a live impact dashboard
Admin, manager and field-employee apps in one installable PWA
Client portal for pickup requests, impact and certificates
Pickup pipeline from request to weighed, processed and certified
Auto-generated Certificates of Disposal as branded PDFs
Automation and AI features across day-to-day operations
features: Books and tracks waste pickups from request to certificate
Verifies field attendance with geofence, live selfie and GPS trail
Pushes real-time updates by web push, in-app sockets and email
Generates branded Certificates of Disposal as downloadable PDFs
Gives clients a self-service portal for pickups, certificates and impact
Works offline as an installable app on Android, iOS and desktop

title: Attendance you can trust,
even without a signal.
craft.body: Field teams work from trucks and plant floors with patchy connectivity. Check-ins are geofenced, require a live selfie, and queue offline with background sync, replaying when the phone reconnects. Managers approve attendance against location and photo evidence instead of taking it on trust.

ai: AI and automation features across daily operations
outcome: Every pickup, check-in and certificate now leaves a record ReSrishti can trust and audit.

quote.text: Cosmiron transformed fragmented operations across WhatsApp and spreadsheets into a unified platform built for teams and clients to work smarter.
quote.by: Nagaraj, Director, ReSrishti (GreenEarth Integrated Facility Pvt. Ltd.)
